`c->check_struct(this)` - checks the ResourceTypeRecord (8 bytes) is in the blob. Passes.

`get_resource_count()` returns `resCountM1 + 1` if tag is sfnt, else 0.

`resourcesZ.sanitize(c, type_base, get_resource_count(), data_base)`:
```cpp
template <typename T>
inline bool sanitize (hb_sanitize_context_t *c, unsigned int count, const void *base, T user_data) const
{
  TRACE_SANITIZE (this);
  if (unlikely (!sanitize_shallow (c, count))) return_trace (false);
  for (unsigned int i = 0; i < count; i++)
    if (unlikely (!arrayZ[i].sanitize (c, base, user_data)))
      return_trace (false);
  return_trace (true);
}
```

`sanitize_shallow(c, count)`:
```cpp
inline bool sanitize_shallow (hb_sanitize_context_t *c, unsigned int count) const
{
  TRACE_SANITIZE (this);
  return_trace (c->check_array (arrayZ, count));
}
```

`arrayZ` = `type_base + resourcesZ`. If `resourcesZ` offset is valid (not 0), `arrayZ` is in the blob. `check_array(arrayZ, count)` checks that `count` ResourceRecords are in the blob. Passes if valid.

Then for each resource record, `arrayZ[i].sanitize(c, type_base, data_base)` = `ResourceRecord::sanitize(c, data_base)`:
```cpp
return_trace (c->check_struct (this) &&
              offset.sanitize (c, data_base) &&
              get_face (data_base).sanitize (c));
```

`c->check_struct(this)` - checks the ResourceRecord (12 bytes) is in the blob. Passes.

`offset.sanitize(c, data_base)` where `data_base` = null pool:
```cpp
template <typename T1>
inline bool sanitize (hb_sanitize_context_t *c, const void *base, T1 d1) const
{
  return_trace (sanitize_shallow (c, base) &&
                (this->is_null () ||
                 StructAtOffset<Type> (base, *this).sanitize (c, d1) ||
                 neuter (c)));
}
```

`sanitize_shallow(c, data_base)`:
- `c->check_struct(this)` - checks the `offset` field (3 bytes) is in the blob. Passes.
- `this->is_null()` - `offset` has has_null=false. So returns false even if offset is 0.
- `c->check_range(data_base, *this)` - checks `data_base + offset` is in the blob. `data_base` = null pool. `check_range` checks `start <= null_pool && null_pool <= end`. Since null_pool is not in the blob, this FAILS.

So `offset.sanitize` returns false. So `ResourceRecord::sanitize` returns false. So `resourcesZ.sanitize` returns false. So `ResourceTypeRecord::sanitize` returns false. So `ArrayOfM1::sanitize` returns false. So `typeList.sanitize` returns false. So `ResourceMap::sanitize` returns false. So `map.sanitize` returns false. So `ResourceForkHeader::sanitize` returns false.
